name: ami-ES2004a (AMI, full 17.5 min)
source: AMI Corpus ES2004a (CC-BY-4.0), single distant microphone, whole meeting. Embeddings from Ronda's own pipeline (int8 WeSpeaker ResNet34), one per single-speaker span of at least 800 ms, labelled with the annotated speaker where one covers more than half the span.
